Scope and evidence: Reviewed the actual frozen XLSX with openpyxl (Quality Checks row 5, Internal Quality Checks row 5, and relevant Deterministic Checks row 31), the frozen Harbor SKILL and matching reference sections. The Internal annotation's old no-network phrase is overridden by the shipped public-network profile. A read-only SHA256 comparison verified all 84 task/rule manifest entries with zero mismatches, bound to input 27f81c18259555d26b61a5a2b0f026f0360b7380bc072523513b0ad2deca9efc. TOML parsing found 1 Render, 1 Constraints, 64 Functional, 7 Polish and 6 Visual criteria; every criterion and all five complete prompts plus injected app_context were inspected.

Runtime contract (paths below are relative to the frozen task): instruction.md:5 directs the implementer to all six /instructions notes and /assets/seed_data.json, and instruction.md:9 asks for the finished app, source and built frontend in /app. environment/instructions/integration.md:3 states Node 22 and Express/better-sqlite3 through NODE_PATH; :5 explicitly states 'node /app/server.js', '0.0.0.0:3000', '/app/public/index.html' and 'GET /api/health'; :7 states '/app/app.db unless DB_PATH supplies a different location', reload/process durability and no duplicated records; :9 says the seed has no snippets/implementation, examples must ship in /app, and /assets or /instructions cannot be runtime dependencies; :11 gives the one-process/local-server/no-startup-install requirements and permits external browser assets; :13 states the symlink boundary. These agree with tests/test.sh:48, :68, :97-111 and :136/:160-167 (health URLs, entry, 3000 and DB_PATH), the localhost URLs in all five judge prompts, and solution/solve.sh:4-7/:26 (copying the finished app including server.js). The launcher is byte-identical to the frozen template. PATH/HOME are ordinary launch plumbing, not extra product behavior; no varying PORT or HOME-dependent implementation is demanded. No fixed calendar clock, date-dependent product outcome, fixed-now injection or date-bearing seed exists; the temporal contract is instead the explicitly disclosed elapsed five-second run/callback budget in behaviour.md:9 and security.md:5. Accounts are explicitly absent in instruction.md:1, overview.md:7 and policy.md:3, matching tests/app_context.md:8. Seed_data.json:3 has an empty snippets array; examples are expressly authored by the builder.

Reverse coverage of graded demands: Render's authored Run in tests/gates/render/judge.toml:23-27 follows instruction.md:1/7 and overview.md:3; Constraints' health/new-save/clean-context readback in tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:23-29 follows integration.md:5/7 and overview.md:7, with no mandated endpoint/body/schema. Functional S01 startup/examples/editable user copy comes from instruction.md:5/7 and overview.md:3/9. S02 filename dispatch, case handling, fresh JS/HTML and inert CSS snapshot come from overview.md:5 and behaviour.md:5/27. S03 completed-preview interaction and Stop, S04 cancellation and rollback, S09 loops, and S36 shared callback deadline come from behaviour.md:7-13 and security.md:3/5. S05 origin/storage isolation, S07 snippet-only networking, S08 explicit unsupported-family refusal and harmless words, and S21's bounded text-only storage canary come from security.md:3/7/9/11. S10-S13 exact one-based JS/full-HTML/timer/Promise error lines and recovery come from behaviour.md:13/15; plain-string Promise reasons are not excluded by that public promise. S14-S16 console levels/order/value inspection/history/clear/elapsed durations and S17 debounce/off/manual Run come from behaviour.md:19/21. S19 editor face/gutter/three-language colouring comes from ui.md:5. S21 exact save/load fields, S22 durable identities/revisions/restart writes, S23 both stale-editor cycles with dirty draft retention, and S24 trimming/empty/case-sensitive uniqueness come from behaviour.md:25-29 and integration.md:7. S34 both themes and preservation of the ongoing work follow ui.md:9 and the brief's working-editor request; no initial theme, authored-document recolouring or theme persistence is imposed. The more precise probes choose examples of these public promises rather than add execution families, syntax palettes, API shapes, account roles or source frameworks.

All seven Polish criteria (tests/scored/polish/judge.toml:23, :32, :41, :50, :59, :68, :77) are grounded in instruction.md:7 and ui.md:3/7/9: usable narrow layout, labelled controls, keyboard reachability, visible focus, navigation and comprehensible workspace/action feedback. Its prompt:43-47 permits menus/composites, ordinary unsaved warnings and standard editor escape without documentation. All six Visual anchored criteria concern the readable, coherent workspace and adaptive narrow-screen presentation already asked for in instruction.md:7 and ui.md:3/9; tests/scored/visual/prompt.md:35-43 explicitly allows native/simple styling and does not require custom branding or decorations.

Adversarial checks were source-level, not app/judge runs. A conforming vanilla-JS frontend with server-rendered library data, arbitrary labels/routes, initial dark theme, standard undocumented Escape/Tab, hidden pending candidates and static restored preview is allowed by policy.md:5, integration.md:3, behaviour.md:13, ui.md:9 and corresponding prompt allowances (functional:5/11/15/17/19, polish:29-30/43-47, visual:37/42-43); no false-failure requirement was found. A hardcoded preview plus browser-only saved library is a plausible broken alternative, but the two gate descriptions require newly authored rendered/logged markers and a newly written record retrieved from an independent clean context; it cannot legitimately earn those gates by its initial sample/localStorage. The actual judge's implementation of those instructions was not exercised, so this is not an empirical false-pass claim. The raw-evidence index explicitly says full configured verifier, Oracle, target-model and judge-workload evidence is absent. None is claimed or waived here: this Pass is limited to row 04's public statement/reverse-coverage source assessment.
